ValidationRule.description: When Core IO is true and Stage is changed to Closed Won, Opportunity Support Rep must be populated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: Core_IO__c = true && ISPICKVAL( StageName , "Closed Won") && ISCHANGED(StageName) && ISBLANK( Support_Rep__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot close a Core IO opportunity if the support rep field is null. Reach out to a CSM manager as they assign the support rep.
